fromDate.description: Inclusive start of the period used to resolve date-scoped metadata.

toDate.description: Inclusive end of the period used to resolve date-scoped metadata.

languages.description: Distinct nonblank language codes available during the requested period.

currencies.description: Distinct nonblank currency codes available during the requested period.

products.description: Product metadata, or null when catalog metadata was not returned.

variants.description: Variant metadata, or null when catalog metadata was not returned.

productCategories.description: Product category metadata, or null when catalog metadata was not returned.

brands.description: Brand metadata, or null when catalog metadata was not returned.

content.description: Content metadata, or null when content metadata was not returned.

contentCategories.description: Content category metadata, or null when content metadata was not returned.

users.description: User metadata, or null when user metadata was not returned.

companies.description: Company metadata, or null when company metadata was not returned or is unavailable for the Dataset.

description: Languages, currencies, and optionally requested entity metadata available for a Dataset.
